description: c115 input-pillar coverage: drives the FULL SDL -> ImGui -> actionmap -> menugraph pipeline using real key events only (no action injection). Sister tests (mp_room_flow, mission_intro_flow, vehicle_flow) use action-injection to bypass focus / windowID concerns; this test deliberately exercises smokePushKey + windowID stamping (iter-2 follow-up 7531cece) + ImGui SDL2 backend forwarding + actionmap fireVk dispatch + menugraph edge fire. Boots via --launch-mp-room base:arena_mp_felicity base:combat 4 --main-menu; --main-menu arms g_PostExitMainMenuView=0 so main_menu auto-opens at ~13s, before the agent_select dialog can gate the screen. The test then drives: Return on main_menu (proves Return reaches actionmap as ACTION_USE; main_menu row 0 = Solo Play push, which triggers MENUPOOL release/acquire churn around 13.44s as evidence the Return was consumed), Down/Up arrows (drive ImGui nav cursor; no edge expected from cursor motion, only confirms smokePushKey gets to the SDL queue with correct scancode), Escape (CANCEL trigger=25 -> MENU.GRAPH.FIRE source=main_menu edge=close ok=1 -- the canonical full-pipeline assertion). Failure of any required_lines pattern indicates a regression in the SDL -> ImGui -> actionmap -> menugraph chain (e.g., windowID gate dropping events, ImGui backend mis-routing, actionmap VK -> action mapping breaking, or menugraph dispatcher failing).

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --launch-mp-room seeds g_MatchConfig + 4 bots; --main-menu arms g_PostExitMainMenuView=0 so main_menu auto-opens at ~13.2s with cursor on row 0 (Solo Play). agent_select dialog is bypassed by the --main-menu arm in this flow (it only appears later if the user backs out of main_menu).

main_menu row 0 (Solo Play) accept. Drives FULL pipeline: smokePushKey -> SDL_PushEvent windowID stamped -> imgui_impl_sdl2 windowID gate passes -> pdguiProcessEvent -> actionmapDispatch fireVk scancode 40 -> action=ACTION_USE (trigger=24). The Solo Play push routes through legacy menuhandler (not menugraph dispatcher), so MENU.GRAPH.FIRE may or may not log for this transition; the assertion target is the MENUPOOL release/acquire churn that proves the Return was consumed downstream.

Down arrow moves ImGui nav cursor row 0 -> row 1 in whatever submenu Solo Play pushed. Edge does NOT fire on cursor motion (only on accept), so the assertion target here is the SMOKE: tap-press scancode=81 marker (proves arrow keys reach the harness queue with correct scancode).
Up back to row 1 -- exercises the inverse arrow path (scancode=82).

main_menu close: Escape -> ACTION_CANCEL_USE (trigger=25) -> MENU.GRAPH.FIRE source=main_menu edge=close trigger=25 dest=pop_to_root. This IS the canonical full-pipeline assertion -- if the SDL -> ImGui -> actionmap -> menugraph chain is healthy, this exact line fires. If the chain is broken anywhere, this line is missing and the test fails.
settle for the deferred imgui_menu pop after Escape so INPUTCTX: imgui_menu on_pop fires before the scripted exit.
scripted exit -- locks in regression coverage of the full SDL key pipeline through the Escape -> CANCEL -> menugraph close edge.
